01 / Sport Integrity Across the Continuum

Sport Integrity Across the Continuum.

I bring integrity to every encounter with athletes, teams, and support personnel. Through clinical precision, respectful communication, safeguarding awareness, and accountable practice, I uphold both the integrity of the process and the dignity of the individual.

Athlete-Centered Care & Well-Being

My technical skill and precision are grounded in clinical practice as a Acupuncturist, Medical Laboratory Assistant, and Phlebotomist.

My approach to care draws on recovery-informed practice, community health, mediation, education, and safeguarding training. I see every encounter as an opportunity to bring these skills and perspectives to the athlete’s experience of care—upholding dignity, privacy, agency, and comfort while maintaining procedural integrity.

Clear Communication

Native fluency in English and conversational proficiency in French. I communicate procedures, rights, and responsibilities clearly and respectfully, supporting understanding throughout the testing process.

Comfort & Dignity

I draw on acupuncture and phlebotomy experience to provide precise needle technique, attentive care, and respectful communication.

Discretion & Safeguarding

Proficient in discreet, confidential athlete notification. I protect privacy, respect personal boundaries, and remain attentive to individual needs and accessibility.

Technical Collection Skills

DCO/BCO trained, with proficiency in observed urine collection, venipuncture, finger-stick collection, and blood collection for the Athlete Biological Passport (ABP).

Consent, Aseptic Technique & Aftercare

I explain collection procedures, confirm understanding, and obtain and document consent as required by the applicable protocol. I use aseptic technique and provide post-collection care and guidance, remaining attentive to athlete comfort.

Documentation & Procedural Integrity

I maintain accurate collection records, specimen integrity, and secure chain of custody. I document deviations from protocol, athlete comments, and actions taken, and report them through the appropriate channels.

100%

03 / Mission Ready

Mission Ready.

Thoughtful preparation supports a calm collection experience and dependable fieldwork.

  • Sharps container
  • Tourniquets
  • Single-use needles and holders
  • Required blood collection tubes
  • Approved sample and transport kits
  • Gloves and hand hygiene supplies
  • Alcohol swabs, gauze and dressings
  • Biohazard waste bags
  • Cooler and temperature logger, when required
  • Documentation and current credentials

04 / Clean Sport Education

From Consent to Compliance

As an ITA-trained International Clean Sport Educator, I bring a community health and prevention education perspective to athlete learning.

Rights & Responsibilities

Clear, accessible education about testing procedures, athlete rights, responsibilities, and the questions athletes can ask.

Respectful Learning

Communication grounded in dignity, health literacy, active listening, and awareness of stigma.

Recovery-Informed Sport Integrity

A developing body of writing exploring what sport integrity can learn from recovery education, lived experience, trust, and person-centered support. This space will share reflections and articles as they are completed.
